SELECT [MedicaidID], [PlanCovDesc], [RefID1], [TapeDate],EligBeginDate,EligEndDate FROM [Enroll].[DBO].[Kansas_Eligibility]  WHERE PlanCovDesc = 'PRIOR ASSIGNMENT'    AND REFID1 IN ('United Healthca', 'Sunflower Healt')   AND TapeDate >= DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)   AND TapeDate < DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)   AND EligEndDate>= DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)   AND EligEndDate < DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)   Order By Tapedate ASC
